fusions.name: Searing Mouthful
fusions.desc: Spits a gobbet of flame that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Last Course
fusions.desc: A searing bite that deals 16 damage and devours every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spit-Roast
fusions.desc: Roasts every body within 8 tiles, up to 5, and eats them: each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Gorging Blaze
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
